name: Tamilnadu Steel Tubes Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1979, Tamil Nadu Steel Tubes Ltd manufactures and sells Black Pipe (ERW Pipe) & G.I. Pipe[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TNSTL is an ISI: 1239 / 1161 / 3601 / 492 
and ISO 9001:2015 certified, one of South 
India's oldest and largest manufacturer of 
quality Mild Steel Tubes, offering a diverse range of over 250 products, including Black 
and Galvanized tubes, available in Round, Square, and Rectangle for industries like Agriculture, Oil & Gas, Infrastructure, and Automotive, etc.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.75% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.51% over last 3 years.
